newsitem.title: FRANCE: Sollac to raise French steel prices for packaging.
newsitem.headline: Sollac to raise French steel prices for packaging.

text.p: Sollac, the flat products unit of Usinor Sacilor, said on Friday that it will increase by four percent the price of its steel products used for packaging in France as of January 1, 1998.
In a statement Sollac linked the rise to higher minerals and coal costs.
Sollac also said it will carry out similar rises in Germany and in northern Europe but was considering stronger price increases for Italy and Spain.

"The objective being for price levels in these countries to match the French or German level in 1999 in order to have similar prices in Europe, the year targeted for European monetary union," it said.
Sollac is not considering raising prices in the UK in the face of the current level of sterling.
